video_title: Brandon Williams notes shift in Warriors' confidence on offense | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: When you checked in in the second quarter, two immediate buckets right there. You were like a racehorse coming out of the gates. How did it feel to you?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Williams
text_blocks.text: It felt great. I was just so excited to be back playing, to be around the team again, just to be on the court. Basketball is my safe space where I get to be me, and to be able to do that tonight with the teammate, it's in our coaches, it was it was one of the world.

quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on returning to the court after injury
quotes.excerpt: Basketball is my safe space where I get to be me
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on returning to the court after injury: Basketball is my safe space where I get to be me.

structured.context: Brandon Williams discusses his return to the court after an injury during a postgame interview.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You had to watch that Celtics game. This one had a different flavor, okay? 37 assists, the balls hopping, the threes are falling. What's the flow of the offense feel like tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Williams
text_blocks.text: I don't know, the ball was just moving. They were finding open guys. We didn't have a lid over the rim today, so that's always a plus. But as long as we're finding guys, finding the open guys, making the right play, I think that's the most important thing. We can live with the results, make or miss.

quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on the Warriors' offensive flow and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: As long as we're finding guys, finding the open guys, making the right play, I think that's the most important thing.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on the Warriors offensive flow: We did not have a lid over the rim today. As long as we are finding guys and making the right play, we can live with the results.

structured.context: Brandon Williams reflects on the Warriors offensive performance and ball movement following a win.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You faced an opponent that does have a struggling defense. So lots of guys can get involved. You've got seven players in double-digit scoring. What does that do for the confidence as you guys try to build?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Williams
text_blocks.text: It builds great confidence, especially in these cup games. We're going to go up to Portland and try to get a win there in advance. But like you said, it just builds confidence as a group. The last week or two has been pretty rough for us as a whole. So games like this should just help us carry momentum to the next game.

quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on building team confidence through balanced scoring
quotes.excerpt: It builds great confidence, especially in these cup games.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams says the Warriors are looking to carry momentum into their next game after a rough stretch: It builds great confidence, especially in these cup games.

structured.context: Brandon Williams discusses how balanced scoring helps build team confidence ahead of an upcoming game against Portland.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams

text_blocks.speaker: Kerith Burke
text_blocks.text: Tell me about De'Anthony Melton's role in this win, eight three-pointers, seven assists.

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Williams
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I mean he did a little bit of everything. He was hooping. He was finding the ball, the ball was going in, he was finding other guys when he when he didn't have it. A real complete game from him, I'm happy.

quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams praises De'Anthony Melton's complete performance
quotes.excerpt: He was finding the ball, the ball was going in, he was finding other guys
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on DeAnthony Melton after his eight three-pointer performance: He was hooping. A real complete game from him.
